comments.text:
Also just so it kinda hits harder, you know how age verification basically isolates the kids into "kid zones" by barring them from "adult" areas of social media.

Think for a second how that would actually lead to abusers having an even easier time targetting kids, not only are they away from most eyes (Let's be honest the vast majority of adults are not Ped°s and if they saw something sketchy they ideally would report it to authorities), but by making an area "Designated for kids" while having the piss poor moderation that Meta and most social media has, it means you are corraling kids in a singular spots, a bad guy just has to deny their IDs to be designated "kid" and has access to that area.

It will cause the opposite of protecting kids from this.

It's why I keep saying, the right moderation has to be, forcing SM companies to have a main feed that is chronological, no algorithmic, with no promoted content. 

Create stronger data protection and regulate algorithmic feeds based on personalized data.

Create a minimum set standard for moderation tools required.

Make features like autoplay and infinite scroll opt in and default off.

That would actually protect not only kids but everyone.
